title: Arc heading
description: A large section heading in the display face at regular weight (42px on phones, 64px on desktop, 1.1 leading, slightly tightened), left-aligned in a narrow measure or centred for a hero. Fades and rises 15px as it scrolls into view.
notes: the reveal needs CSS scroll-driven animations; elsewhere the heading simply shows
name: arc-heading

props.name: as
props.description: the heading level to render (default h2)

props.name: reveal
props.description: fades and rises in as it scrolls into view (default true)
